text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The General Secretariat (GS) is the nerve centre of the Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications (DETEC).", "gist": "GS is the central hub for DETEC"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "As such, it coordinates the activities of the various Federal Offices within DETEC.", "gist": "GS coordinates activities of DETEC's Federal Offices"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Given the interconnected nature of many of these activities, this coordination role is essential.", "gist": "Coordination is essential due to interconnected activities"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The GS prepares Federal Council business, assists with policy planning, liaises with parliament and handles internal and external communication.", "gist": "GS is responsible for preparing Federal Council business, policy planning, parliamentary liaison, and communication"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The GS also manages DETEC resources and acts in an ownership capacity in dealings with SwissPost, SBB, Swisscom and Skyguide, making sure that strategic objectives set by the Federal Council have been met.", "gist": "GS manages DETEC resources and oversees SwissPost, SBB, Swisscom, Skyguide to ensure Federal Council strategic objectives are met"}]}
